statement.zh: 唐代伟大的浪漫主义诗人李白出生于碎叶城（今吉尔吉斯斯坦托克马克附近）。李白字太白，号青莲居士，五岁时随父迁居绵州昌隆（今四川江油）。他一生创作了大量脍炙人口的诗歌，风格豪放飘逸、想象瑰丽，被后人尊称为'诗仙'。代表作品有《静夜思》《望庐山瀑布》《将进酒》等，其诗歌对中国文学产生了深远影响。
statement.en:
Li Bai, the great romantic poet of the Tang dynasty, was born in Suyab (near modern-day Tokmok, Kyrgyzstan). Li Bai, courtesy name Taibai, art name Qinglian Jushi, moved with his father to Changlong, Mianzhou (modern Jiangyou, Sichuan) at age five. He wrote a large number of popular poems in a bold, unrestrained and imaginative style, and was revered as the 'Immortal Poet'. His representative works include 'Quiet Night Thought', 'The Waterfall in Mount Lu Viewed from Afar', and 'Bringing in the Wine'. His poetry had a profound influence on Chinese literature.

For Asia in 701 CE, “Birth of Li Bai” is a traceable node of Figure change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: The Taihō code: Tang institutions become Japanese law

summary.en: The Taihō code was compiled in 701 as the administrative and penal code of the early Nara period, modelled on Tang codes. It turned central organs, the kuni–gun–ri hierarchy, and local appointments into executable articles.

statement.zh: 《大宝律令》在701年编成，是奈良时代早期的行政与刑事法典，以唐律令为蓝本，行用到8世纪后期。

sources.locator: Opening: date, nature, Tang model, period in force
sources.excerpt: Taihō code, (ad 701), in Japan, administrative and penal code of the Taihō era early in the Nara period, modeled on the codes of the Chinese T’ang dynasty (618–907) and in force until the late 8th century.

zh: 《大宝律令》在701年编成，是奈良时代早期的行政与刑事法典，以唐律令为蓝本，行用到8世纪后期。
en: The Taihō code was compiled in 701 as the administrative and penal code of the early Nara period, modelled on Tang codes and in force until the late 8th century.

statement.zh: 它把中央政府机构、国—郡—里层级与地方官任免写成可执行的条文。
statement.en: It turned central government organs, the kuni–gun–ri hierarchy, and the appointment of local officials into executable articles.

sources.locator: Administrative structure: central organs, provinces, districts, townships
sources.excerpt: It provided for the establishment of the central-government administrative organs; of provinces (kuni) ruled by governors (kokushi) who were appointed by the central government; districts (gun, or kōri) administered by district governors (gunji) selected locally from the gentry; and townships of 50 households, governed by headmen.

zh: 它把中央政府机构、国—郡—里层级与地方官任免写成可执行的条文。
en: It turned central government organs, the kuni–gun–ri hierarchy, and the appointment of local officials into executable articles.

statement.zh: 法典包括行政法的“令”与刑事法的“律”。
statement.en: The code included administrative ryō and penal ritsu.

sources.locator: Contents: administrative ryō and penal ritsu
sources.excerpt: Provisions included not only administrative laws (ryō) but also penal laws (ritsu), which concerned matters of arrest and imprisonment.

zh: 法典包括行政法的“令”与刑事法的“律”。
en: The code included administrative ryō and penal ritsu.

zh: 原文已不存，内容大体保存在718年的《养老律令》里。
en: The original is lost; its content survives largely in the Yōrō code of 718.

statement.zh: 公元704年，武则天年事已高，张易之、张昌宗兄弟把持朝政，引起朝臣不满。宰相张柬之等人密谋恢复李唐社稷，为次年神龙政变埋下伏笔。武则天统治后期政治腐败，但她在位期间稳定了边疆、发展了经济、完善了科举，为开元盛世奠定了基础。
statement.en:
In 704, Wu Zetian was advanced in age. The Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong brothers controlled the court, causing discontent among officials. Chancellor Zhang Jianzhi and others plotted to restore the Tang dynasty, laying the groundwork for the Shenlong Coup the following year. Although Wu Zetian's later reign saw political corruption, she had stabilized the frontiers, developed the economy, and improved the imperial examination system during her time in power, setting the stage for the Kaiyuan Golden Age.

For Asia in 704 CE, “Political Turmoil in Wu Zetian's Late Reign” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 公元705年十二月，武则天病逝于洛阳上阳宫，享年82岁。临终遗诏去帝号，称“则天大圣皇后”，与唐高宗合葬于乾陵。武则天是中国历史上唯一正统的女皇帝，执政近半个世纪，在位期间推行科举、发展经济、巩固边疆，为开元盛世奠定了基础。
statement.en:
In December 705, Wu Zetian died of illness at the Shangyang Palace in Luoyang at the age of 82. In her final edict, she renounced the title of emperor and was called 'Holy Empress Zetian', and was buried with Emperor Gaozong of Tang in the Qianling Mausoleum. Wu Zetian was the only orthodox female emperor in Chinese history. She ruled for nearly half a century, promoting the imperial examinations, developing the economy, and consolidating the frontiers, laying the foundation for the Kaiyuan Golden Age.

For Asia in 705 CE, “Death of Wu Zetian” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

公元705年十二月，武则天病逝于洛阳上阳宫，享年82岁。
en: In December 705, Wu Zetian died of illness at the Shangyang Palace in Luoyang at the age of 82. In her final edict, she renounced the title of emperor and was called 'Holy Empress Zetian', and was buried with Emperor Gaozong of Tang in the Qianling Mausoleum. Wu Zetian was the only orthodox female emperor in Chinese history. She ruled for nearly half a century, promoting the imperial examinations, developing the economy, and consolidating the frontiers, laying the foundation for the Kaiyuan Golden Age.

title.en: The Small Wild Goose Pagoda is built

summary.en: The Tang built the Small Wild Goose Pagoda at the Jianfu Temple in Chang'an, a graceful multi-eaved brick tower paired with its giant namesake as the 'twin pagodas of Chang'an'.

statement.zh:

statement.zh: 公元708年，吐蕃军队进犯陇右地区，唐军将领郭元振率军迎击。唐军在洮州（今甘肃临潭）大败吐蕃军，斩首数千级，缴获大量牛羊辎重。此次胜利巩固了唐朝西部边疆，使吐蕃暂时不敢东犯。郭元振随后在边境设置烽燧和屯田，加强防御体系。
statement.en:
In 708, Tibetan forces raided the Longyou region. Tang general Guo Yuanzhen led the army to counterattack. The Tang army decisively defeated the Tibetans at Tao Prefecture (modern Lintan, Gansu), killing thousands and capturing large amounts of livestock and supplies. This victory consolidated Tang's western frontier and deterred Tibetan incursions for a time. Guo Yuanzhen then set up beacon towers and garrison farms to strengthen the defensive system.

For Asia in 708 CE, “Tang Defeats Tibet” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Arab Empire Advances into Central Asia

summary.en: In 708, Umayyad general Qutayba ibn Muslim crossed the Amu Darya and attacked Ferghana and Samarkand. The Arab army adopted a strategy of divide and rule, allying with some Sogdian city-states to fight against Tang's vassals in the Western Regions. By 711, the Arabs had basically controlled the Transoxiana region, and Islam began to spread into the interior of Central Asia.

title.en: Arab Army Reaches the Indus River

summary.en: In 709, Umayyad general Muhammad ibn al-Qasim led forces to attack the Indus Valley. The Arabs captured the important city of Debal in Sindh, defeating the local Hindu ruler. By 712, the Arabs had fully conquered Sindh, bringing Islam into the Indian subcontinent. The Arabs established strongholds along the Indus River as a base for further eastward expansion.

title.en: Beginning of Iconoclasm in the Byzantine Empire

summary.en: In the early 8th century, Byzantine Emperor Leo III began to promote iconoclastic policies. He believed that the veneration of icons violated the commandment against idolatry and ordered the removal of icons and frescoes from churches. This policy met strong opposition from monasteries and the Pope, leading to a century-long iconoclastic controversy that deepened the schism bet

statement.zh: 公元8世纪初，拜占庭帝国皇帝利奥三世开始推行圣像破坏政策。
statement.en: In the early 8th century, Byzantine Emperor Leo III began to promote iconoclastic policies.

zh: 公元8世纪初，拜占庭帝国皇帝利奥三世开始推行圣像破坏政策。
en: In the early 8th century, Byzantine Emperor Leo III began to promote iconoclastic policies.

statement.en: He believed that the veneration of icons violated the commandment against idolatry and ordered the removal of icons and frescoes from churches.

zh: 他认为崇拜圣像违反了“不可拜偶像”的诫命，下令拆除教堂中的圣像和壁画。
en: He believed that the veneration of icons violated the commandment against idolatry and ordered the removal of icons and frescoes from churches.

statement.en: This policy met strong opposition from monasteries and the Pope, leading to a century-long iconoclastic controversy that deepened the schism between Eastern and Western Christianity.

title.en: Heijō-kyō and Tōdai-ji: Buddhism inside the state machine

summary.en: In 710 the capital moved to Heijō-kyō (Nara), the first permanent capital, laid out like Tang Chang'an. In 741 the kokubunji system was established, in 743 Tōdai-ji and its Great Buddha were initiated, and in 752 the image was dedicated.

statement.zh: 710年，日本把首都迁到平城京（奈良）。
statement.en: In 710 the capital was moved to Heijō-kyō (Nara).

sources.locator: Opening: Nara period 710–784; first permanent capital
sources.excerpt: Nara period, (ad 710–784), in Japanese history, period in which the imperial government was at Nara, and Sinicization and Buddhism were most highly developed. Nara, the country’s first permanent capital, was modeled on the Chinese T’ang dynasty (618–907) capital, Ch’ang-an.

zh: 710年，日本把首都迁到平城京（奈良）。
en: In 710 the capital was moved to Heijō-kyō (Nara).

statement.zh: 这是第一座常驻首都，城市布局仿唐长安；奈良时代延续到784年，汉化与佛教在这里同时达到高点。
statement.en: It was the first permanent capital, laid out on the model of Tang Chang'an; the Nara period lasted until 784, when Sinicization and Buddhism both reached a high point.

sources.locator: Opening: first permanent capital; Sinicization and Buddhism
sources.excerpt: Nara period, (ad 710–784), in Japanese history, period in which the imperial government was at Nara, and Sinicization and Buddhism were most highly developed. Nara, the country’s first permanent capital, was modeled on the Chinese T’ang dynasty (618–907) capital, Ch’ang-an.

zh: 这是第一座常驻首都，城市布局仿唐长安；奈良时代延续到784年，汉化与佛教在这里同时达到高点。
en: It was the first permanent capital, laid out on the model of Tang Chang'an; the Nara period lasted until 784, when Sinicization and Buddhism both reached a high point.

statement.zh: 741年，圣武天皇在各国建立国分寺与国分尼寺，把地方寺院纳入以奈良为中心的体系；743年又发起建造东大寺与卢舍那大佛。
statement.en: In 741 Emperor Shōmu established a monastery and a nunnery in each province, tying local temples to a Nara-centred system; in 743 he initiated Tōdai-ji and its Vairocana Great Buddha.

sources.locator: Nara period: kokubunji system and Tōdai-ji
sources.excerpt: In 741 he established the kokubunji system, building a monastery and a nunnery in each province, all under a central authority at Nara. In 743 he initiated the planning for construction of that central authority—the Tōdai Temple—and of its central image, a massive bronze statue of the Birushana (Vairocana) Buddha, known as the Great Buddha (Daibutsu).

zh: 741年，圣武天皇在各国建立国分寺与国分尼寺，把地方寺院纳入以奈良为中心的体系；743年又发起建造东大寺与卢舍那大佛。
en: In 741 Emperor Shōmu established a monastery and a nunnery in each province, tying local temples to a Nara-centred system; in 743 he initiated Tōdai-ji and its Vairocana Great Buddha.

statement.zh: 大佛殿745年开工，752年举行开眼供养，坐佛高近15米。
statement.en: Construction of the Great Buddha Hall began in 745, dedication was held in 752, and the seated figure stands nearly 15 metres high.

sources.locator: Great Buddha Hall: construction in 745, dedication in 752, height
sources.excerpt: The construction of the Great Buddha Hall (Daibutsuden) commenced in 745, and dedication ceremonies for the nearly 15-metre- (50-foot-) high seated figure were held in 752.

zh: 大佛殿745年开工，752年举行开眼供养，坐佛高近15米。
en: Construction of the Great Buddha Hall began in 745, dedication was held in 752, and the seated figure stands nearly 15 metres high.

statement.zh: 奈良的中央政府设太政官与诸省，另设神祇官；天皇称“天皇”，既是官僚体系顶点，也是神祇祭祀的中心。
statement.en: The Nara central government had a Council of State and ministries, plus an Office of Deities; the sovereign took the title tennō and stood both at the apex of the bureaucracy and at the centre of Shintō ceremony.

sources.locator: Government: Council of State, ministries, Office of Deities, tennō
sources.excerpt: With the adoption of the imperial title tennō, translated from the Chinese t’ien-huang, or “heavenly emperor,” the Chinese concept of the emperor as the supreme symbol of central government rule was incorporated into the native Japanese interpretation of the emperor as also the leading Shintō cult figure. Like its T’ang Chinese prototype, the Japanese central government consisted of a Council of State (Dajōkan) and ministries of Rites, Personnel, Public Works, War, Justice and Revenue. An Office of Deities (Jingikan) supervised Shintō official ceremonies.

zh: 奈良的中央政府设太政官与诸省，另设神祇官；天皇称“天皇”，既是官僚体系顶点，也是神祇祭祀的中心。
en: The Nara central government had a Council of State and ministries, plus an Office of Deities; the sovereign took the title tennō and stood both at the apex of the bureaucracy and at the centre of Shintō ceremony.

statement.zh: 宗教不是国家的私事，而是国家工程的一部分。
statement.en: Religion was not a private matter; it was part of the state project.

zh: 宗教不是国家的私事，而是国家工程的一部分。
en: Religion was not a private matter; it was part of the state project.

Heijō-kyō was designed as a grid pattern imitating Tang Chang'an, about 4.3 km east-west and 4.8 km north-south. statement.en: In 710, Empress Genmei of Japan moved the capital from Fujiwara-kyō to Heijō-kyō (modern Nara), beginning the Nara period.

en: In 710, Empress Genmei of Japan moved the capital from Fujiwara-kyō to Heijō-kyō (modern Nara), beginning the Nara period.

statement.zh: 公元711年，唐睿宗李旦在位期间，太平公主因拥立之功权势日盛。她大肆提拔党羽，七位宰相中有五位出自其门下，与太子李隆基的矛盾日益激化。太平公主试图废黜李隆基，另立听话的太子。睿宗试图调解双方矛盾，但未能成功，最终于712年禅位于李隆基。
statement.en:
In 711, during the reign of Emperor Ruizong, Princess Taiping's influence grew due to her role in his ascension. She promoted her own followers extensively; five of the seven chancellors were her protégés. Her conflict with Crown Prince Li Longji intensified. Princess Taiping attempted to depose Li Longji and install a more pliable crown prince. Ruizong tried to mediate but failed, eventually abdicating in favor of Li Longji in 712.

For Asia in 711 CE, “Princess Taiping's Growing Power” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 公元711年，唐睿宗李旦在位期间，太平公主因拥立之功权势日盛。她大肆提拔党羽，七位宰相中有五位出自其门下，与太子李隆基的矛盾日益激化。太平公主试图废黜李隆基，另立听话的太子。睿宗试图调解双方矛盾，但未能成功，最终于712年禅位于李隆基。
公元711年，唐睿宗李旦在位期间，太平公主因拥立之功权势日盛。
en: In 711, during the reign of Emperor Ruizong, Princess Taiping's influence grew due to her role in his ascension. She promoted her own followers extensively; five of the seven chancellors were her protégés. Her conflict with Crown Prince Li Longji intensified. Princess Taiping attempted to depose Li Longji and install a more pliable crown prince. Ruizong tried to mediate but failed, eventually abdicating in favor of Li Longji in 712.
In 711, during the reign of Emperor Ruizong, Princess Taiping's influence grew due to her role in his ascension.

statement.zh: 公元712年八月，唐睿宗李旦禅位于太子李隆基，李隆基在长安太极宫登基为帝，是为唐玄宗。玄宗即位后改元先天，时年28岁。他励精图治，任用姚崇、宋璟为相，整顿吏治、发展经济、改革军事，开启了长达44年的统治。玄宗在位前期开创了开元盛世，后期因宠幸杨贵妃、重用安禄山而引发安史之乱。
statement.en:
In August 712, Emperor Ruizong abdicated in favor of Crown Prince Li Longji, who ascended the throne at Taiji Palace in Chang'an as Emperor Xuanzong of Tang. He was 28 years old. He worked diligently, appointing Yao Chong and Song Jing as chancellors, reforming officialdom, developing the economy, and reforming the military, beginning a 44-year reign. In the early part of his reign, Xuanzong created the Kaiyuan Golden Age; later, due to his favoritism toward Consort Yang and reliance on An Lushan, he triggered the An-Shi Rebellion.

For Asia in 712 CE, “Emperor Xuanzong Ascends the Throne” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

en: In August 712, Emperor Ruizong abdicated in favor of Crown Prince Li Longji, who ascended the throne at Taiji Palace in Chang'an as Emperor Xuanzong of Tang. He was 28 years old. He worked diligently, appointing Yao Chong and Song Jing as chancellors, reforming officialdom, developing the economy, and reforming the military, beginning a 44-year reign. In the early part of his reign, Xuanzong created the Kaiyuan Golden Age; later, due to his favoritism toward Consort Yang and reliance on An Lushan, he triggered the An-Shi Rebellion.

title.en: Emperor Xuanzong Establishes the Jiedushi System

Initially, ten jiedushi were established: Anxi, Beiting, Hexi, Longyou, Shuofang, Hedong, Fanyang, Pinglu, Jiannan, and Lingnan. The jiedushi system was intended to improve border defense

title.en: Yao Chong and Song Jing Serve as Chancellors

summary.en: In 715, Emperor Xuanzong appointed Yao Chong as chancellor. Yao was expert in officialdom, cutting redundant offices and reforming finances. Yao was followed by Song Jing, who was upright, selected the capable, and restrained the powerful. Yao Chong and Song Jing were praised as 'Yao and Song', representing the wise chancellors of the early Kaiyuan period. With their assistance

statement.zh: 公元715年，唐玄宗任用姚崇为宰相，姚崇精通吏治，裁汰冗官，整顿财政。姚崇之后，宋璟继任宰相，他刚正不阿，选拔贤能，抑制权贵。姚崇和宋璟被誉为“姚宋”，是开元初年的贤相代表。在他们的辅佐下，唐朝政治清明，经济繁荣，国力达到鼎盛。
statement.en:
In 715, Emperor Xuanzong appointed Yao Chong as chancellor. Yao was expert in officialdom, cutting redundant offices and reforming finances. Yao was followed by Song Jing, who was upright, selected the capable, and restrained the powerful. Yao Chong and Song Jing were praised as 'Yao and Song', representing the wise chancellors of the early Kaiyuan period. With their assistance, the Tang government became clean, the economy prospered, and national power reached its peak.

For Asia in 715 CE, “Yao Chong and Song Jing Serve as Chancellors” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In 717, Emperor Xuanzong dismissed Chancellor Yao Chong and appointed Song Jing as Zhongshu Ling. Yao Chong resigned after being impeached for mishandling a locust plague and for his relatives accepting bribes. Song Jing continued Yao's reform policies. He enforced laws strictly, restrained the powerful, and selected the capable. During Song Jing's tenure, Tang's officialdom became even cleaner, ensuring the continued development of the Kaiyuan Golden Age.

He enforced laws strictly, restrained the powerful, and selected the capable. During Song Jing's tenure, Tang's officialdom became even cleaner, ensuring the continued development of the Kaiyuan Golden Age.

title.en: Yi Xing Measures the Earth's Meridian

summary.en: In 725, Tang astronomer Yi Xing conducted the first large-scale astronomical survey in Chinese history. He organized personnel to select thirteen observation points on the Henan plain, measuring the shadow length of a gnomon to calculate the length of one degree of the Earth's meridian as about 351 li and 80 bu (approximately 131.3 km). This result came 90 years before the firs

statement.zh: 公元725年，唐朝天文学家僧一行主持了中国历史上第一次大规模天文测量。他组织人员在河南平原选择十三个测点，用圭表测量日影长度，计算出地球子午线一度的弧长约为三百五十一里八十步（约合今131.3公里）。这一数据比西方最早的同类测量早90年，是古代天文学的重要成就。
statement.en:
In 725, Tang astronomer Yi Xing conducted the first large-scale astronomical survey in Chinese history. He organized personnel to select thirteen observation points on the Henan plain, measuring the shadow length of a gnomon to calculate the length of one degree of the Earth's meridian as about 351 li and 80 bu (approximately 131.3 km). This result came 90 years before the first similar measurement in the West, representing a major achievement in ancient astronomy.

For Asia in 725 CE, “Yi Xing Measures the Earth's Meridian” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In 727, the Tibetan king Tri Detsuktsen led a large force to attack the Hexi region. The Tibetans captured Guazhou (modern Guazhou, Gansu), taking Prefect Tian Renxian prisoner, and cut the Tang's communication route to the Western Regions. Emperor Xuanzong ordered Hexi Jiedushi Wang Junchuo to counterattack. Wang defeated the Tibetan pursuers at the foot of the Qilian Mountains and recovered Guazhou. However, Wang was later killed in battle, leaving the Tang's western frontier in a serious situation.

statement.zh: 公元732年十月，法兰克王国宫相查理·马特率领法兰克军队在普瓦捷与图尔之间击败了由阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼率领的倭马亚阿拉伯远征军。阿拉伯骑兵的冲锋被法兰克步兵方阵抵挡住，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼在战斗中阵亡，阿拉伯军队被迫撤回西班牙。此战阻止了伊斯兰势力向欧洲腹地的扩张，查理·马特因此获得“铁锤”绰号，其子丕平后来建立了加洛林王朝。
statement.en:
In October 732, Charles Martel, Mayor of the Palace of the Frankish kingdom, led Frankish forces to defeat the Umayyad expeditionary army led by Abd al-Rahman al-Ghafiqi between Poitiers and Tours. The charges of the Arab cavalry were stopped by Frankish infantry squares, and Abd al-Rahman was killed in the battle. The Arab army retreated to Spain. This battle halted the expansion of Islam into the heart of Europe, and Charles Martel earned the nickname 'the Hammer'. His son Pepin later founded the Carolingian dynasty.

In 732 CE, “Battle of Tours (Battle of Poitiers)” belongs to the field of Military in Europe.

statement.zh: 公元735年，圣卜尼法斯在查理·马特的支持下，在德意志地区建立了多个主教区，包括美因茨、帕绍和雷根斯堡。他整顿了日耳曼教会的纪律，废除了异教习俗，使基督教在日耳曼地区广泛传播。圣卜尼法斯后来被尊为“德意志使徒”，他的传教活动促进了日耳曼部落的文明化和法兰克王国的基督教化。
statement.en:
In 735, with the support of Charles Martel, Saint Boniface established several bishoprics in Germany, including Mainz, Passau, and Regensburg. He reformed discipline in the German church, abolished pagan customs, and spread Christianity widely among the Germanic peoples. Boniface was later revered as the 'Apostle to the Germans'. His missionary work promoted the Christianization of the Frankish kingdom and the civilization of Germanic tribes.

For Europe in 735 CE, “Saint Boniface Establishes Bishoprics in Germany” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In 737, war broke out between Tang and the Turgesh Khaganate in Central Asia. The Turgesh khagan Suluk, allied with Tibet, attacked Tang positions in the Western Regions. Tang Anxi Jiedushi Gai Jiayun led his forces against them. The two sides fought a fierce battle around Suyab (modern Tokmok, Kyrgyzstan), and the Tang army eventually repelled the Turgesh, stabilizing the situation in the Western Regions. The following year, civil war broke out in the Turgesh khaganate, Suluk was killed, and Tang regained suzerainty over Central Asia.

For Asia in 737 CE, “Tang-Turgesh War” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Height of the Maya Kingdom of Copán

summary.en: In the mid-8th century, Maya civilization entered its Late Classic period, and the kingdom of Copán reached its peak. Copán, located in modern western Honduras, was one of the most important Maya city-states. King Uaxaclajuun Ubʼaah Kʼawiil (r. 695–738) built numerous pyramids, altars, and stelae. statement.zh: 公元8世纪中期，玛雅文明进入古典期后期，科潘王国达到鼎盛。科潘位于今洪都拉斯西部，是玛雅地区最重要的城邦之一。国王十八兔在位期间（约695-738年）建造了大量金字塔、祭坛和石碑，科潘的象形文字阶梯是玛雅最长的石刻铭文。738年，十八兔被基里瓜国王俘获并处死，科潘进入衰落期。
statement.en:
In the mid-8th century, Maya civilization entered its Late Classic period, and the kingdom of Copán reached its peak. Copán, located in modern western Honduras, was one of the most important Maya city-states. King Uaxaclajuun Ubʼaah Kʼawiil (r. 695–738) built numerous pyramids, altars, and stelae. Copán's Hieroglyphic Stairway is the longest carved Maya inscription. In 738, the king was captured and executed by the rival city-state of Quiriguá, and Copán entered a period of decline.

For North America in 738 CE, “Height of the Maya Kingdom of Copán” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 公元739年，日本圣武天皇下诏在平城京（奈良）建造东大寺。东大寺是日本佛教华严宗的总本山，主殿大佛殿是世界上最大的木结构建筑之一。寺内铸有高约15米的卢舍那大佛铜像，动用全国铜矿资源才得以完成。东大寺的建造体现了奈良时代佛教国教化政策，也消耗了日本大量的国力和民力。
statement.en:
In 739, Emperor Shōmu of Japan issued an edict to build Tōdai-ji temple in Heijō-kyō (Nara). Tōdai-ji is the head temple of the Japanese Kegon school of Buddhism. Its main hall, the Daibutsuden, is one of the largest wooden structures in the world. Inside is a bronze statue of the Great Buddha (Vairocana), about 15 meters tall, which consumed the nation's copper resources. The construction of Tōdai-ji reflected the Nara period's policy of making Buddhism a state religion, but it also consumed enormous resources and labor.

For Asia in 739 CE, “Emperor Shōmu of Japan Orders Construction of Tōdai-ji” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Chen Cangqi compiles 'Supplements to the Materia Medica'

summary.en: In 739 (Kaiyuan 27) Chen Cangqi of Siming completed the Bencao Shiyi (Supplements to the Materia Medica) in ten volumes. statement.zh: 唐开元27年（739年），四明人陈藏器撰成《本草拾遗》十卷。他认为官修《新修本草》遗漏尚多，遂遍访民间医方，补录草药692种，并订正原书讹误。书中首创“十剂”分类——宣、通、补、泄、轻、重、涩、滑、燥、湿，按药性功用而非单纯依形态归类，为后世方书沿用千余年。李时珍称其“博极群书，精核物类”，《本草纲目》大量引录其说，"陈藏器曰"凡数百条。原书宋以后散佚，今存内容多赖《证类本草》《本草纲目》转引而幸免湮没。
statement.en:
In 739 (Kaiyuan 27) Chen Cangqi of Siming completed the Bencao Shiyi (Supplements to the Materia Medica) in ten volumes. Judging the official Newly Revised Materia Medica still incomplete, he travelled widely among folk practitioners, added 692 medicinal substances and corrected errors in the earlier work. The book introduced the "ten categories" of drugs—dispersing, unblocking, tonifying, purging, light, heavy, astringent, slippery, drying and moistening—classifying medicines by therapeutic action rather than form alone, a scheme used for the next thousand years. Li Shizhen praised his learning and quoted him in hundreds of entries in the Bencao Gangmu. The original was lost after the Song and survives only through such later quotations.

For Asia in 739 CE, “Chen Cangqi compiles 'Supplements to the Materia Medica'” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 公元740年，唐代著名山水田园诗人孟浩然病逝，终年51岁。孟浩然是唐代山水诗的先驱，与王维并称“王孟”。他的诗歌清新自然，意境幽远，代表作有《春晓》《过故人庄》《宿建德江》等。孟浩然一生布衣，不事权贵，晚年隐居襄阳鹿门山。他的诗风对后世中国诗歌产生了深远影响。
statement.en:
In 740, the great Tang landscape poet Meng Haoran died of illness at the age of 51. Meng Haoran was a pioneer of landscape poetry in the Tang, often mentioned together with Wang Wei as 'Wang-Meng'. His poetry is fresh and natural, with a serene and remote mood. Representative works include 'Spring Morning', 'Visiting an Old Friend's Cottage', and 'Mooring on the River at Jiande'. Meng Haoran remained a commoner his whole life, refusing to serve the powerful, and spent his later years in seclusion in Lumen Mountain. His poetic style had a profound influence on later Chinese poetry.

In October 741, Frankish Mayor of the Palace Charles Martel died of illness. Charles Martel was the de facto ruler of the Franks at the end of the Merovingian period. He defeated the Arab army at the Battle of Tours, preventing the expansion of Islam into the heart of Europe. His benefice reforms strengthened cavalry and laid the foundation for the Carolingian Empire. After his death, his sons Pepin the Short and Carloman inherited power.

statement.en:
In 743, Emperor Shōmu of Japan ordered the casting of the Great Buddha at Tōdai-ji. The casting project took nearly a decade, consuming the nation's copper resources and huge amounts of labor and wealth. The Buddha is about 15 meters tall and resides in the Great Buddha Hall of Tōdai-ji. Emperor Shōmu hoped to pray for peace and protection through this act, but the enormous cost aggravated social contradictions and accelerated the decline of the ritsuryō state.

An Lushan seized the opportunity to request also being appointed Fanyang Jiedushi, which was granted, further expanding his military power.

title.en: Li Bai Summoned to Court as Hanlin Academician

summary.en: In 744, Li Bai was summoned to the capital by Emperor Xuanzong to serve as a Hanlin academician, a literary attendant to the emperor responsible for drafting edicts and accompanying him on excursions. statement.zh: 公元744年，李白应唐玄宗诏令入京，担任翰林待诏。翰林待诏是皇帝身边的文学侍从，负责草拟诏书和陪侍游宴。李白在长安宫中写下了《清平调》三首，赞美杨贵妃的美貌。但因性格狂放不羁，得罪了高力士和杨国忠，不到两年便被唐玄宗赐金放还。这次入京是李白的最后一次从政经历。
statement.en:
In 744, Li Bai was summoned to the capital by Emperor Xuanzong to serve as a Hanlin academician, a literary attendant to the emperor responsible for drafting edicts and accompanying him on excursions. In the palace, Li Bai wrote three poems under the tune 'Qingping Diao', praising the beauty of Consort Yang. However, his uninhibited personality offended Gao Lishi and Yang Guozhong, and less than two years later, he was dismissed with a gift of gold. This summons was Li Bai's last experience in government.

For Asia in 744 CE, “Li Bai Summoned to Court as Hanlin Academician” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Li Bai and Du Fu Become Friends

summary.en: In 745, Li Bai and Du Fu met in Luoyang and formed a deep friendship. They traveled together in the Liang-Song region (modern Kaifeng and Shangqiu, Henan), seeking Taoist teachings and composing poems while drinking. statement.zh: 公元745年，李白与杜甫在洛阳相遇，结下深厚友谊。两人同游梁宋（今河南开封、商丘一带），一起访道求仙，饮酒赋诗。杜甫在诗中写道：“醉眠秋共被，携手日同行。”李白比杜甫大十一岁，两人友谊成为唐代文坛的一段佳话。此后杜甫写下了多首怀念李白的诗篇，表达对这位前辈诗人的敬仰之情。
statement.en:
In 745, Li Bai and Du Fu met in Luoyang and formed a deep friendship. They traveled together in the Liang-Song region (modern Kaifeng and Shangqiu, Henan), seeking Taoist teachings and composing poems while drinking. Du Fu wrote in a poem: 'Drunk, we slept with our robes overlapping; hand in hand, we traveled by day.' Li Bai was eleven years older than Du Fu, and their friendship became a celebrated story in Tang literary circles. Du Fu later wrote many poems expressing his admiration for Li Bai.

For Asia in 745 CE, “Li Bai and Du Fu Become Friends” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

In 745, Emperor Xuanzong conferred the title of Imperial Consort (Guifei) on Yang Yuhuan, who had previously been the consort of Prince Shou. To please her, Xuanzong spent enormous sums to transport fresh lychees from Lingnan to Chang'an, inspiring the famous line 'The red dust of a single ride raised a lady's smile.' In 746, the Tang dynasty's territory reached its largest historical extent: east to the Taedong River basin in Korea, west to the Pamir Mountains and the Aral Sea, north to Lake Baikal, and south to the Heng Mountains in Vietnam. The directly ruled area of Tang was about 10 million square kilometers, making it one of the largest empires in the world at the time.

statement.zh: 公元747年，安禄山入朝献俘，唐玄宗因其战功进封为东平郡王。唐朝节度使封王自此始，这是唐朝对藩镇权力失控的标志性事件。安禄山随后请求兼任河东节度使，获得批准。他一人兼任平卢、范阳、河东三镇节度使，拥兵十五万，掌握了唐朝最精锐的边防军，安史之乱的隐患已经形成。
statement.en:
In 747, An Lushan came to court to present captives, and for his military achievements Emperor Xuanzong promoted him to Prince of Dongping. This was the first time a Tang jiedushi had been enfeoffed as a prince, a sign of the court's loss of control over regional military governors. An Lushan then requested and was granted the concurrent position of Hedong Jiedushi. He now held three jiedushi positions (Pinglu, Fanyang, Hedong) simultaneously, commanding 150,000 troops, the most elite frontier forces of Tang. The seeds of the An-Shi Rebellion had already sprouted.

For Asia in 747 CE, “An Lushan's Power Overwhelms the Court” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In 750, Abu al-Abbas defeated the Umayyad army at the Battle of the Great Zab River in Iraq and established the Abbasid Caliphate. The Abbasids moved the capital from Damascus east to Baghdad, marking the shift of the center of Islamic civilization from Syria to Mesopotamia. Under caliphs such as Harun al-Rashid and al-Ma'mun, the Abbasid Caliphate entered the Islamic Golden Age. The House of Wisdom in Baghdad gathered scholars of various ethnicities and achieved remarkable accomplishments in astronomy, mathematics, medicine, and philosophy.

For Asia in 750 CE, “Establishment of the Abbasid Caliphate” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

Gold was secured, often by mute barter, at the southern limits of the empire and was conveyed to the empire’s capital, where a Muslim commercial town developed alongside the native city.

title.en: Bulguksa and Seokguram: faith carved in granite

summary.en: In the 8th century the Silla prime minister Kim Dae-seong initiated and supervised the construction of Bulguksa and Seokguram; Bulguksa was built in 774. Bulguksa consists of wooden halls on raised stone terraces, stone bridges and two pagodas, while Seokguram is an artificial grotto of granite.

statement.zh: 8世纪，新罗宰相金大城发起并监督建造佛国寺与石窟庵；佛国寺于774年建成。
statement.en: In the 8th century the Silla prime minister Kim Dae-seong initiated and supervised the construction of Bulguksa and Seokguram; Bulguksa was built in 774.

sources.locator: Brief synthesis，Kim Dae-seong 与 Bulguksa 774 句
sources.excerpt: Prime Minister Kim Dae-seong initiated and supervised the construction of the temple and the grotto, the former built in memory of his parents in his present life and the latter in memory of his parents from a previous life. ... The Temple of Bulguksa (built in 774) and the Seokguram Grotto form a religious architectural complex of exceptional significance.

zh: 8世纪，新罗宰相金大城发起并监督建造佛国寺与石窟庵；佛国寺于774年建成
en: In the 8th century the Silla prime minister Kim Dae-seong initiated and supervised the construction of Bulguksa and Seokguram; Bulguksa was built in 774

statement.zh: 佛国寺由木构殿宇、抬高石台、石桥与两座石塔组成，布局表现佛国净土；木构历经重修，石构件保存。
statement.en: Bulguksa consists of wooden halls on raised stone terraces, stone bridges and two pagodas, its layout representing the land of Buddha; the wooden buildings were repaired, while the stone elements survive.

sources.locator: Outstanding Universal Value，Bulguksa 结构与净土句
sources.excerpt: Bulguksa is a Buddhist temple complex that comprises a series of wooden buildings on raised stone terraces. The grounds of Bulguksa are divided into three areas ... These areas and the stone terraces were designed to represent the land of Buddha. The stone terraces, bridges and the two pagodas – Seokgatap (Pagoda of Sakyamuni) and Dabotap (Pagoda of Bountiful Treasures) – facing the Daeungjeon attest to the fine masonry work of the Silla.

zh: 佛国寺建在吐含山山坡上，以木构殿宇、抬高石台、石桥和两座石塔组成，整体布局意在表现佛国净土；现存木构建筑历经重修，石台、石桥与石塔仍保存下来
en: Bulguksa stands on the slopes of Mount Toham and consists of wooden halls on raised stone terraces, stone bridges and two pagodas, its layout intended to represent the land of Buddha; the wooden buildings have been repaired several times, while the stone terraces, bridges and pagodas survive

statement.zh: 石窟庵是花岗岩人工石窟，由前室、走廊与圆形主室组成；穹顶与入口使用三百六十多块石板，佛像与周围浮雕被视为东亚佛教艺术杰作。
statement.en: Seokguram is an artificial granite grotto with an antechamber, corridor and circular rotunda; its dome and entrance use more than 360 stone slabs, and the Buddha with surrounding reliefs is regarded as a masterpiece of East Asian Buddhist art.

sources.locator: Outstanding Universal Value，Seokguram 结构与石板句
sources.excerpt: Seokguram is an artificial grotto constructed of granite that comprises an antechamber, a corridor and a main rotunda. It enshrines a monumental statue of the Sakyamuni Buddha ... The domed ceiling of the rotunda and the entrance corridor employed an innovative construction technique that involved the use of more than 360 stone slabs.

sources.locator: Outstanding Universal Value，Criterion (i) 句
sources.excerpt: The Seokguram Grotto, with its statue of Buddha surrounded by Bodhisattvas, the Ten Disciples, Eight Divine Guardians, two Devas, and two Vajrapanis all carved from white granite, is a masterpiece of East Asian Buddhist Art.

zh: 石窟庵是用花岗岩砌成的人工石窟，由前室、走廊与圆形主室组成，主室供奉释迦牟尼坐像；穹顶与入口通道使用三百六十多块石板，佛像周围的菩萨、弟子与神将浮雕被视为东亚佛教艺术的杰作
en: Seokguram is an artificial grotto of granite with an antechamber, a corridor and a main rotunda, enshrining a seated Sakyamuni Buddha; its dome and entrance passage use more than 360 stone slabs, and the reliefs of bodhisattvas, disciples and guardian deities around the Buddha are regarded as a masterpiece of East Asian Buddhist art

statement.zh: 木构可以重修，石构件把神圣空间的骨架固定在山坡上；石窟把造像、礼拜路线与工程计算封进一个圆形内室。
statement.en: Wooden halls can be repaired; stone elements fix the skeleton of the sacred space to the hillside; the grotto seals sculpture, worship route and engineering calculation inside one circular chamber.

zh: 石头与木头在这里各有分工：木构殿宇可以重修，石台、石桥与石塔把神圣空间的骨架固定在山坡上；石窟则把造像、礼拜路线与工程计算一起封进一个圆形内室
en: Stone and wood have different jobs here: wooden halls can be repaired, while terraces, bridges and pagodas fix the skeleton of the sacred space to the hillside; the grotto seals sculpture, worship route and engineering calculation inside one circular chamber

statement.zh: 公元751年七月，唐朝安西节度使高仙芝率三万唐军与阿拔斯王朝将领阿布·穆斯林统帅的二十万阿拉伯军队在怛罗斯（今哈萨克斯坦塔拉兹）会战。唐军与葛逻禄部落联军先胜后败，葛逻禄临阵倒戈，唐军溃败，高仙芝仅率数千人逃回安西。此战唐朝失去了对中亚的控制，阿拉伯帝国巩固了在中亚的统治。被俘的唐朝工匠将造纸术传入阿拉伯世界。
statement.en:
In July 751, Tang Anxi Jiedushi Gao Xianzhi led 30,000 Tang troops against an Abbasid army of 200,000 led by Abu Muslim at Talas (modern Taraz, Kazakhstan). The Tang army initially gained the upper hand against the combined force of Arabs and Karluk tribes, but the Karluks defected midway, causing the Tang army to collapse. Gao Xianzhi escaped back to Anxi with only a few 1000 men. This battle led to Tang losing control over Central Asia, while the Arab Empire consolidated its rule there. Captured Tang craftsmen introduced paper-making to the Arab world.

For Asia in 751 CE, “Battle of Talas” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 公元751年七月，唐朝安西节度使高仙芝率三万唐军与阿拔斯王朝将领阿布·穆斯林统帅的二十万阿拉伯军队在怛罗斯（今哈萨克斯坦塔拉兹）会战。唐军与葛逻禄部落联军先胜后败，葛逻禄临阵倒戈，唐军溃败，高仙芝仅率数千人逃回安西。此战唐朝失去了对中亚的控制，阿拉伯帝国巩固了在中亚的统治。被俘的唐朝工匠将造纸术传入阿拉伯世界。

en: In July 751, Tang Anxi Jiedushi Gao Xianzhi led 30,000 Tang troops against an Abbasid army of 200,000 led by Abu Muslim at Talas (modern Taraz, Kazakhstan). The Tang army initially gained the upper hand against the combined force of Arabs and Karluk tribes, but the Karluks defected midway, causing the Tang army to collapse. Gao Xianzhi escaped back to Anxi with only a few 1000 men. This battle led to Tang losing control over Central Asia, while the Arab Empire consolidated its rule there. Captured Tang craftsmen introduced paper-making to the Arab world.

summary.en: In July 756, Crown Prince Li Heng ascended the throne in Lingwu (modern Lingwu, Ningxia) as Emperor Suzong, honoring Xuanzong as retired emperor. statement.zh: 公元756年七月，太子李亨在灵武（今宁夏灵武）即皇帝位，是为唐肃宗，尊玄宗为太上皇。肃宗任命郭子仪为朔方节度使、李光弼为河东节度使，调集西北边军平叛。同时向回纥借兵，约定平定叛乱后，“土地、士庶归唐，金帛、子女皆归回纥”。肃宗的即位稳定了平叛的领导核心。
statement.en:
In July 756, Crown Prince Li Heng ascended the throne in Lingwu (modern Lingwu, Ningxia) as Emperor Suzong, honoring Xuanzong as retired emperor. Suzong appointed Guo Ziyi as Shuofang Jiedushi and Li Guangbi as Hedong Jiedushi, and mobilized northwestern frontier troops to suppress the rebellion. He also sought troops from the Uyghur Khaganate, agreeing that after the rebellion was put down, 'the land and people shall return to Tang, but the gold, silk, and women shall go to the Uyghurs.' Suzong's ascension stabilized the leadership core of the counter-rebellion effort.

For Asia in 756 CE, “Emperor Suzong Ascends the Throne in Lingwu” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In June 756, An Lushan's rebel forces broke through Tong Pass, and Geshu Han was defeated and captured. Emperor Xuanzong fled in panic to Sichuan. At Mawei Station (modern Xingping, Shaanxi), the imperial guards mutinied, killing Chancellor Yang Guozhong and forcing Xuanzong to order Consort Yang strangled. Xuanzong reluctantly ordered Gao Lishi to strangle Consort Yang, who was 38 years old. Xuanzong then fled to Chengdu, while Crown Prince Li Heng went north to Lingwu to organize resistance.

In September 757, Guo Ziyi led a combined Tang and Uyghur force of 150,000 to a decisive battle against the rebels at Xiangji Temple on the western outskirts of Chang'an. statement.zh: 公元758年九月，唐肃宗命郭子仪、李光弼等九位节度使率六十万大军围攻安庆绪据守的邺城（今河南安阳）。唐军围城数月，掘壕引水灌城，叛军困守待援。但由于肃宗猜忌将领，不设元帅，诸将互不统属，久攻不下。次年三月，史思明率援军赶到，唐军大败，邺城之围瓦解。
statement.en:
In September 758, Emperor Suzong ordered nine jiedushi led by Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi to invest Yecheng (modern Anyang, Henan), where An Qingxu was holed up. The Tang forces besieged the city for months, digging moats and damming rivers to flood it. The rebels were trapped and awaiting relief. However, because Suzong distrusted his generals, he did not appoint a supreme commander, and the various commanders were not subordinate to each other, leading to a protracted siege. In March of the following year, Shi Siming arrived with relief forces, and the Tang army was badly defeated, and the siege collapsed.

For Asia in 758 CE, “Nine Jiedushi Besiege Yecheng” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 公元760年，杜甫在安史之乱中流离失所，创作了诗史名篇《三吏》（《新安吏》《石壕吏》《潼关吏》）和《三别》（《新婚别》《垂老别》《无家别》）。
statement.en: In 760, during the chaos of the An-Shi Rebellion, Du Fu composed the famous historical poems 'Three Officials' ('Recruiting Officer at Xinyi', 'Officer at Shihao', 'Officer at Tong Pass') and 'Three Farewells' ('Farewell to Newlyweds', 'Farewell of an Old Man', 'Farewell of a Homeless Man').

en: In 760, during the chaos of the An-Shi Rebellion, Du Fu composed the famous historical poems 'Three Officials' ('Recruiting Officer at Xinyi', 'Officer at Shihao', 'Officer at Tong Pass') and 'Three Farewells' ('Farewell to Newlyweds', 'Farewell of an Old Man', 'Farewell of a Homeless Man').

statement.zh: 公元762年，李白在安徽当涂病逝，终年61岁。李白晚年因参与永王李璘幕府被流放夜郎，中途遇赦。他在去世前写下了《临终歌》，感叹一生抱负未展。李白是唐代最伟大的浪漫主义诗人，存诗九百余首，其诗歌想象瑰丽、语言奔放，对后世文学产生了深远影响。
statement.en:
In 762, Li Bai died of illness in Dangtu, Anhui, at the age of 61. In his later years, Li Bai had been exiled to Yelang for joining the staff of Prince Li Lin, but was pardoned on the way. In his last poem, 'Singing on His Deathbed', he lamented his unfulfilled ambitions. Li Bai was the greatest romantic poet of the Tang dynasty, with over 900 extant poems. His poetry, with its splendid imagination and vigorous language, had a profound influence on later literature.

For Asia in 762 CE, “Death of Li Bai” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 公元762年，李白在安徽当涂病逝，终年61岁。李白晚年因参与永王李璘幕府被流放夜郎，中途遇赦。他在去世前写下了《临终歌》，感叹一生抱负未展。李白是唐代最伟大的浪漫主义诗人，存诗九百余首，其诗歌想象瑰丽、语言奔放，对后世文学产生了深远影响。

en: In 762, Li Bai died of illness in Dangtu, Anhui, at the age of 61. In his later years, Li Bai had been exiled to Yelang for joining the staff of Prince Li Lin, but was pardoned on the way. In his last poem, 'Singing on His Deathbed', he lamented his unfulfilled ambitions. Li Bai was the greatest romantic poet of the Tang dynasty, with over 900 extant poems. His poetry, with its splendid imagination and vigorous language, had a profound influence on later literature.

statement.en:
In the first month of 763, Shi Chaoyi, defeated and cornered, committed suicide in Fanyang. The eight-year An-Shi Rebellion was finally pacified. The Tang counter-rebellion effort came at a heavy cost: the population fell from about 52 million before the war to 17 million; the economy was severely damaged; a Fanzhen separatist pattern emerged; and Tibet took advantage to capture the Hexi Corridor. The An-Shi Rebellion was the turning point of Tang's decline, after which Tang fell into a pattern of Fanzhen separatism and eunuch domination.

For Asia in 763 CE, “An-Shi Rebellion Suppressed” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In October 763, the Tibetan Emperor Trisong Detsen led 200,000 troops into Guanzhong, catching Tang unprepared. Emperor Daizong fled in haste to Shanzhou (modern Sanmenxia, Henan). The Tibetan forces captured Chang'an and installed Li Chenghong as emperor. They plundered the city for fifteen days. Guo Ziyi led a counterattack, and the Tibetans withdrew from Chang'an. This was the first time the Tang capital was captured by a foreign power, marking the collapse of Tang's western frontier defenses.

title.en: Empress Shōtoku Ascends the Throne in Japan

summary.en: In 766, Empress Shōtoku ascended the throne in Japan. Empress Shōtoku was the title taken by the former Empress Kōken after her abdication. She had a controversial relationship with the monk Dōkyō, causing discontent at court. During Empress Shōtoku's reign, Dōkyō interfered in politics and attempted to usurp the throne. After her death, Dōkyō was exiled. During this period, th

statement.zh: 公元766年，日本称德天皇即位。称德天皇是孝谦天皇退位后的称号，她因与道镜和尚有暧昧关系而引起朝廷不满。称德天皇在位期间，道镜干预朝政，企图篡位。称德天皇去世后，道镜被流放。这一时期日本朝廷动荡，律令制国家出现危机。
statement.en:
In 766, Empress Shōtoku ascended the throne in Japan. Empress Shōtoku was the title taken by the former Empress Kōken after her abdication. She had a controversial relationship with the monk Dōkyō, causing discontent at court. During Empress Shōtoku's reign, Dōkyō interfered in politics and attempted to usurp the throne. After her death, Dōkyō was exiled. During this period, the Japanese court was in turmoil, and the ritsuryō state faced crisis.

For Asia in 766 CE, “Empress Shōtoku Ascends the Throne in Japan” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 公元766年，日本称德天皇即位。称德天皇是孝谦天皇退位后的称号，她因与道镜和尚有暧昧关系而引起朝廷不满。称德天皇在位期间，道镜干预朝政，企图篡位。称德天皇去世后，道镜被流放。这一时期日本朝廷动荡，律令制国家出现危机。
公元766年，日本称德天皇即位。
en: In 766, Empress Shōtoku ascended the throne in Japan. Empress Shōtoku was the title taken by the former Empress Kōken after her abdication. She had a controversial relationship with the monk Dōkyō, causing discontent at court. During Empress Shōtoku's reign, Dōkyō interfered in politics and attempted to usurp the throne. After her death, Dōkyō was exiled. During this period, the Japanese court was in turmoil, and the ritsuryō state faced crisis.
In 766, Empress Shōtoku ascended the throne in Japan.

title.en: Partition and takeover: Charlemagne gets the whole Frankish realm

summary.en: In 768 Pippin died and, according to Frankish custom, divided the kingdom between the brothers Charles and Carloman. When Carloman died in 771, Charles disregarded the rights of his heirs and took control of the entire Frankish realm; military campaigning continued for three decades, and the Saxon war only ended in 804.

statement.zh: 768年，丕平去世；按照法兰克习俗，王国分给查理和卡罗曼两兄弟。
statement.en: In 768 Pippin died; according to Frankish custom, the kingdom was divided between the brothers Charles and Carloman.

sources.locator: Biography, Early years: division of the realm in 768

zh: 768年，丕平去世。按照法兰克习俗，王国分给查理和卡罗曼两兄弟。
en: In 768 Pippin died. According to Frankish custom, the kingdom was divided between the brothers Charles and Carloman.

en: When Carloman died in 771, Charles disregarded the rights of Carloman's heirs and took control of the entire Frankish realm.

statement.zh: 查理曼统治的前三十年以军事行动为主；对萨克森的战争最困难、最持久，直到804年才臣服。
statement.en: The first three decades of Charlemagne's reign were dominated by military campaigning; the Saxon war was the most difficult and long-lasting, and the Saxons only submitted in 804.

sources.locator: Top Questions: Saxon war and submission in 804
sources.excerpt: His campaign against the Saxons proved to be his most difficult and long-lasting one. After thirty years of on-again, off-again fighting, betrayed truces, and bloody reprisals enacted by the Franks, the Saxons finally submitted in 804.

zh: 此后三十年，军事行动构成统治的常态：萨克森战争最困难、最持久，直到804年才迫使萨克森人臣服。
en: For the next thirty years, military campaigning was the norm: the Saxon war was the most difficult and long-lasting, and the Saxons only submitted in 804.

statement.zh: 法兰克的分产习惯因此呈现两面：它不断制造内战，也不断给胜者提供并吞的机会。
statement.en: Frankish partible inheritance thus showed two faces: it repeatedly produced civil war, and it repeatedly gave the victor a chance to absorb his rival's share.

statement.zh: 公元770年，杜甫在湖南耒阳病逝，终年58岁。杜甫晚年漂泊湖湘，生活困苦。他在去世前写下了《风疾舟中伏枕书怀》等诗作，感叹一生壮志未酬。杜甫存诗一千四百余首，其诗深刻反映了唐朝由盛转衰的社会现实，被尊为“诗圣”。杜甫和白居易、李白并称为唐代三大诗人。
statement.en:
In 770, Du Fu died of illness in Leiyang, Hunan, at the age of 58. In his later years, Du Fu wandered in the Hunan and Hubei area, living in poverty. Before his death, he wrote poems such as 'On My Deathbed' lamenting his unfulfilled ambitions. Du Fu left over 1,400 poems, which profoundly reflect the social reality of Tang's decline and have earned him the title 'Sage of Poetry'. Du Fu, together with Bai Juyi and Li Bai, are known as the three great poets of the Tang.

statement.en:
In 772, the great Tang poet Bai Juyi was born in Xinzheng, Zhengzhou (modern Xinzheng, Henan). Bai Juyi, courtesy name Letian, art name Xiangshan Jushi, was a leading proponent of the New Yuefu Movement in the Tang, advocating that 'writing should serve the times, and poetry should address reality.' His representative works include 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow', 'Song of the Pipa', and 'The Old Charcoal Seller'. Bai Juyi's poetry is plain and accessible, widely circulated, and had a profound influence on later Chinese literature.

statement.zh: 公元776年，查理曼在罗马举行盛大的复活节庆典，庆祝征服伦巴第的胜利。教皇哈德良一世为查理曼加冕为“罗马人贵族”。这次庆典标志着法兰克王国与教皇国联盟的巩固，也反映了查理曼意欲恢复西罗马帝国荣光的野心。24年后，教皇利奥三世在圣诞节为查理曼加冕为“罗马人的皇帝”。
statement.en:
In 776, Charlemagne held a grand Easter celebration in Rome to celebrate the conquest of Lombardy. Pope Hadrian I crowned Charlemagne 'Patrician of the Romans'. This celebration marked the consolidation of the alliance between the Frankish kingdom and the Papacy, and reflected Charlemagne's ambition to restore the glory of the Western Roman Empire. 24 years later, Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne 'Emperor of the Romans' on Christmas Day.

For Europe in 776 CE, “Charlemagne Celebrates Victory in Rome” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

This celebration marked the consolidation of the alliance between the Frankish kingdom and the Papacy, and reflected Charlemagne's ambition to restore the glory of the Western Roman Empire. 24 years later, Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne 'Emperor of the Romans' on Christmas Day.

statement.en:
After more than twenty years studying tea, Lu Yu produced the Classic of Tea in three scrolls and ten chapters, treating the plant's origins, tools, processing, utensils, boiling, drinking, history, growing regions, simplifications and illustrations. It described the tea plant, picking seasons, the making of compressed cake tea, 24 implements and correct brewing, turning tea from a thirst-quencher into a codified cultural practice. Lu Yu was later revered as the Sage of Tea.

statement.zh: 公元788年，唐德宗任命韦皋为剑南西川节度使。韦皋在蜀地治理近二十年，整顿军政，发展经济，加强边防。他多次击退吐蕃和南诏的入侵，是德宗朝最杰出的边将之一。韦皋治理下的蜀地成为唐朝晚期最富庶的地区之一，为朝廷提供了重要的财源。
statement.en:
In 788, Emperor Dezong appointed Wei Gao as Jiedushi of Jiannan Xichuan. Wei Gao governed the Shu region for nearly twenty years, reorganizing the military, developing the economy, and strengthening border defenses. He repeatedly repelled invasions by Tibet and Nanzhao, becoming one of the most outstanding frontier generals of Dezong's reign. Under Wei Gao's governance, Shu became one of the richest regions in the late Tang, providing an important source of revenue for the court.

For Asia in 788 CE, “Wei Gao Governs Shu” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.en: Wei Gao, Allied with Nanzhao, Crushes Tibet

summary.en: In 791, Jiannan Jiedushi Wei Gao, in alliance with Nanzhao king Yimouxun, launched an attack on Tibet. statement.zh: 公元791年，剑南节度使韦皋联合南诏王异牟寻，共同进攻吐蕃。唐诏联军在泸水大败吐蕃军队，斩杀吐蕃大将，俘虏数万人。这次胜利重创了吐蕃的军事力量，削弱了吐蕃对西南地区的控制。韦皋因功进封为南康郡王。
statement.en:
In 791, Jiannan Jiedushi Wei Gao, in alliance with Nanzhao king Yimouxun, launched an attack on Tibet. The Tang-Nanzhao allied forces decisively defeated the Tibetan army on the Lushui River, killing the Tibetan general and capturing 10,000. This victory severely damaged Tibetan military power and weakened Tibetan control over the southwestern region. Wei Gao was promoted to Prince of Nankang for his merits.

In 792, Bai Juyi passed the jinshi examination at the age of 24. There was a saying in the Tang: 'At thirty you are old for the Mingjing, at fifty you are young for the Jinshi.' statement.en:
In 797 (Enryaku 16), Sugano no Mamichi, Fujiwara no Tsugutada and others completed the Shoku Nihongi on the order of Emperor Kanmu. Continuing the Nihon Shoki, it covers 95 years from 697 (first year of Emperor Monmu) to 791 (Enryaku 10). Written in Chinese in annalistic style and running to forty scrolls, it is the longest of Japan's Six National Histories and the primary source for the Nara period.

For Asia in 797 CE, “Japan completes the Shoku Nihongi” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 公元799年，白居易被任命为校书郎，开始了仕途生涯。校书郎是秘书省的官职，负责校勘典籍。白居易在长安任职期间，与元稹等人结为好友，共同倡导新乐府运动。他创作了《秦中吟》《新乐府》等反映社会现实的诗篇，展现了“文章合为时而著”的文学主张。
statement.en:
In 799, Bai Juyi was appointed a collator (xiaoshu lang), beginning his official career. The collator was a position in the Palace Library responsible for collating texts. During his tenure in Chang'an, Bai Juyi befriended Yuan Zhen and others, together advocating the New Yuefu Movement. He wrote poems such as 'Qin Zhongyin' and 'New Yuefu' that reflected social reality, embodying his principle that 'writing should serve the times, and poetry should address reality.'

For Asia in 799 CE, “Bai Juyi Appointed Editor” is a traceable node of Figure change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 公元799年，白居易被任命为校书郎，开始了仕途生涯。校书郎是秘书省的官职，负责校勘典籍。白居易在长安任职期间，与元稹等人结为好友，共同倡导新乐府运动。他创作了《秦中吟》《新乐府》等反映社会现实的诗篇，展现了“文章合为时而著”的文学主张。
公元799年，白居易被任命为校书郎，开始了仕途生涯。
en: In 799, Bai Juyi was appointed a collator (xiaoshu lang), beginning his official career. The collator was a position in the Palace Library responsible for collating texts. During his tenure in Chang'an, Bai Juyi befriended Yuan Zhen and others, together advocating the New Yuefu Movement. He wrote poems such as 'Qin Zhongyin' and 'New Yuefu' that reflected social reality, embodying his principle that 'writing should serve the times, and poetry should address reality.'
In 799, Bai Juyi was appointed a collator (xiaoshu lang), beginning his official career.

title.en: Coronation at St. Peter's: the imperial title returns to the West

summary.en: In 799 Pope Leo III was attacked in Rome and fled to Charlemagne for protection. At Christmas in 800 Leo crowned Charlemagne in St. Peter's Basilica and proclaimed him "emperor of the Romans"; this was the first restoration of the imperial title in the West since the Western Roman Empire dissolved, and Byzantium only recognised it in 812.

statement.zh: 799年，教皇利奥三世在罗马遭到袭击，逃到查理曼处寻求庇护。

sources.excerpt: In 799 Pope Leo III was physically attacked and fled to the court of Charlemagne, who escorted him back to Rome in 800 and assumed the "formal role" of his protector.

zh: 799年，教皇利奥三世在罗马遭到袭击，逃到查理曼处寻求庇护。
en: In 799 Pope Leo III was attacked in Rome and fled to Charlemagne for protection.

statement.en: At Christmas in 800, Leo III crowned Charlemagne in St. Peter's Basilica in Rome and proclaimed him "emperor of the Romans".

sources.locator: History, Origin of the title: Christmas coronation in St. Peter's
sources.excerpt: On Christmas Day the pope crowned Charlemagne in St. Peter's Basilica, and those assembled proclaimed him "emperor of the Romans."

sources.excerpt: Charlemagne was crowned "emperor of the Romans" by Pope Leo III in 800 CE, thus restoring the Roman Empire in the West for the first time since its dissolution in the 5th century.

en: Byzantium only recognised his imperial title in 812.

statement.zh: 加冕不是单纯的荣誉：它让查理曼可以援引西部帝国的遗产，也让教皇与皇帝的关系变成一场长期谈判。
statement.en: The coronation was not merely an honour: it let Charlemagne claim the legacy of the Western empire and turned the relationship between pope and emperor into a long negotiation.

statement.zh: 米斯特克人在瓦哈卡建造 Monte Albán 风格的石头城，以金工与珠宝闻名。他们在山地间建立城邦与王陵，以手抄本记录谱系与祭祀，金工技艺在失蜡铸造与镶嵌上尤为突出；城邦之间既有联姻也有竞争，形成多中心的格局。米斯特克的艺术与书写传统后来与周边文化交融，影响了瓦哈卡地区的整体面貌。

summary.en: At Tiahuanaco by Lake Titicaca the 'Gate of the Sun' and other megaliths were raised, carved with flying deities and calendrical motifs, a religious and astronomical centre of the southern Andes.

statement.zh:
的的喀喀湖畔的蒂亚瓦纳科建起“太阳门”等巨石建筑，刻有飞神与历法纹样，是安第斯南部的宗教与天文中心。巨石以榫卯与磨光拼接，门楣浮雕把神祇、历法与王权结合；城市与祭祀平台组织周边人口。高原文明由此形成中心。

title.en: Ghana Empire Flourishes in West Africa

summary.en: In 800, the Ghana Empire of West Africa entered its period of florescence. The Ghana Empire controlled West African gold production and the trans-Saharan trade routes, and its kings accumulated vast wealth through monopolizing the gold and salt trade. statement.zh: 公元800年，西非加纳帝国进入兴盛时期。
statement.en: In 800, the Ghana Empire of West Africa entered its period of florescence.

sources.locator: Opening paragraphs
sources.excerpt: Ghana, first of the great medieval trading empires of western Africa (fl. 7th–13th century). ... The first written references to the empire are those of Arabic geographers and historians from the 8th century, and it seems certain that, by 800, Ghana had become rich and powerful. ... The principal raison d’etre of the empire was the desire to control the trade in alluvial gold ... the most important of which was salt ...

zh: 公元800年，西非加纳帝国进入兴盛时期。
en: In 800, the Ghana Empire of West Africa entered its period of florescence.

statement.en: The Ghana Empire controlled West African gold production and the trans-Saharan trade routes, and its kings accumulated vast wealth through monopolizing the gold and salt trade.

zh: 加纳帝国控制着西非的黄金产地和撒哈拉商路，通过垄断黄金和盐的贸易积累了大量财富。

summary.en: The Classic Maya cities of the southern lowlands were abandoned one by one between about 800 and 900 amid drought, soil exhaustion and war; central authority collapsed in what is called the 'Maya collapse'.

statement.zh:
玛雅低地南部的古典城邦约800—900年间因干旱、土壤耗竭与战乱相继废弃，中央政权崩解，史称“玛雅南部衰落”。多因素叠加使城市失去维持人口的能力，贸易网络与王权合法性随之中断；人口向北部与高地迁移。古典文明的终结是长期过程而非单一事件。

把「玛雅南部衰落」放回公元800年的中美洲，可以看到社会变化的一个具体切面。
